claim: Seal-first blinded external validation of a frozen early-season G+E_T1 system on the public 2024 G2F release.
The 2024 evaluation was calendar-time prospective before outcomes became public.
The 2022 available-case cohort supplied negative diagnostic evidence for interval transport.
The frozen B11 90% interval rule recovered admissible 2024 calibration while the carried-forward one-sided guard over-covered and was less efficient.
Calibration error evolves monotonically from season to season.
The 2023 target season was unevaluable under the fixed T1 information interface without inventing a planting-date proxy.
B16 establishes a new error-decomposition methodology.
B16 shows that 2024 failure is mixed: environment offsets plus substantial within-environment error and under-dispersion.
B17 establishes a new response-amplitude transport method.
The additive G+E architecture cannot modulate genotype contrasts by environment in exact arithmetic.
Case Study B validates support-based abstention as a selective-risk mechanism.
Case Study B introduces a new state-of-the-art GxE predictive architecture.
